messages:
maya: kicking off shadow run for FP8 kernels across H100 + L40S. goal: compare FP8 vs AWQ/GPTQ/INT8 baselines on atlas-13b and orion-7b. run id sr-4472. starting with small batch smoke then longprefix eval :eyes:
chris: timeline? canary %? also include kv-cache longcontext tests
maya: canary at 5% traffic for model-serving shadow; eval buckets: caption-eval, qa-regression, longprefix-eval, embed-drift. will run latency perf and quality deltas side-by-side.
eli: FYI FP8 on H100 previously hit NaN with batch>=8 on attn kernel — added saturation clamp in the shim. keep an eye on NaN counters.
sasha: noted. we'll collect `nan_count`, `activation_max`, `scale_histogram` from runtime metrics. perf-bot: running baseline benchmarks now, posting short summary when ready.
perf-bot: baseline complete: AWQ (4-bit) median latency 88ms, GPU util 72% on L40S; GPTQ median 95ms; INT8 optimized kernels 80ms; FP8 (disabled) placeholder 0ms.
maya: pushed FP8 kernel build to staging (h100-l40s-compat branch). simple config used:```
{
  "quant_scheme": "fp8_e4m3",
  "per_channel": true,
  "activation_clamp": 1.2,
  "attention_fallback": "int8_when_saturated"
}```
arjun: small nit — per_channel + fp8 tends to reduce drift but increases kernel cost. make sure batching profile includes small-batch skew (batches 1-4).
chris: any early quality deltas?
maya: first smoke on H100 (batch=1, seq=512): PPL delta +0.6 vs FP32, top-1 QA F1 delta -0.4%. AWQ shows +0.2%, GPTQ +0.7%. embedding cosine drift ~0.003 mean (acceptable).
eli: longprefix-eval (seq=2k) shows subtle coherence drop on H100 FP8: hallucination tokens up at ~0.8% on certain prompts. suspect kv-cache precision mismatch when split across tiling boundaries.
sasha: L40S looks cleaner for longprefix but latency PCR (peak) jumps at seq>1500, probably due to GEMM tiling fallback.
maya: NaN counters on H100 popped twice during a stress run when we used runqueue=auto; switching to runqueue=conservative stopped them. logged trace: `kernel_attn_fp8: scale overflow -> NaN` — will open bug.
arjun: try enabling `pre_activation_clip=0.9` as a mitigation. also try a hybrid path: FP8 for matmuls, INT8 for attention softmax path.
perf-bot: updated numbers after hybrid-fallback: H100 median latency 92ms (vs 88ms AWQ), NaNs gone in 10k tokens smoke. quality deltas: PPL +0.3, QA -0.2%.
maya: canary rollout plan proposal: 5% shadow -> 0% real for 24h, evaluate metrics and regressions, then 20% shadow+5% real for 12h, go/no-go criteria: no P0 quality regression (>1% drop on qa-regression), embedding drift <0.01, no NaN events.
chris: add metric to watch: KV-cache hit rate and per-batch scale variance. also add automated rollback when `nan_count>0` on real traffic.
sasha: we'll make a small dashboard: `fp8_canary/quality`, `fp8_canary/perf`, `fp8_canary/runtime_alerts`. linking traces and the failing trace ids.
maya: QA followups: run ablation between `per_channel=true/false`, `activation_clamp=1.0/1.2/1.5`, and `attention_fallback=int8/none`. also include GPTQ-matched runs for fairness.
eli: note — GPTQ sometimes hides distribution shift on longprefix because it caches quant scales differently; include a per-step perplexity curve.
arjun: don't forget to test with batch skew (80% single-token, 20% longseq) to mirror production chat workload.
maya: agreed. I'll push a matrix job and upload CSVs to s3://redwood-evals/sr-4472.
deploy-bot: canary created: sr-4472-canary-1, 5% shadow attached to atlas-13b, monitor link: https://console.redwood/mon/sr-4472-canary-1
chris: thanks — will keep an eye overnight. if we see hallucination upticks or NaNs we pause. :thumbsup:
maya: closing note — FP8 promising but brittle on H100 tiling/scale edgecases. plan: stabilize with clamping + conservative runqueue, hybrid attention fallback, then iterate on kernel fixes. next sync tomorrow 10am PT.
